messages:
Priya: Found a lone cactus on the windowsill. Is it ours or a stealth office adopt? (pic) 🌵
Dante: It's mine?? I mean it's definitely plotting. :smirk: 
Molly: Name suggestions: Spike, Chairman Meow (for irony), or 'WiFi' because it only connects sometimes. :joy: 
Priya: Voting round — drop a one-liner + react with :one: Spike, :two: Chairman Meow, :three: WiFi. 
eng-bot: FYI: Office thermostat setpoint changed 2°C earlier — plant-friendly mode engaged. :robot_face: 
Zoe: One-liner for Spike: 'Prickly on the outside, secretly judges your lunch choices.' 
Dante: Chairman Meow: 'Runs for office every other Tuesday, vetoes Mondays.' :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: 
Ken: WiFi: 'Strong signal near the cactus, weak signal at your desk. Coincidence?' 
Molly: Also can we confirm nobody is using it as a pen holder? Asking for safety. 
Priya: Tally so far: Spike 1, Chairman Meow 1, WiFi 1 — we are a democracy of indecision. 
Zoe: Quick tie-breaker — shortest one-liner wins. 
Dante: 'Spike: punctures regrets.' 
Molly: 'WiFi: connects when you stop refreshing.' 
Ken: 'Chairman Meow: demands snacks.' 
Priya: Shortest is Ken's — Chairman Meow wins the name. Sticker to Ken. :tada: 
eng-bot: Reminder: If you leave perishable snacks by the plant, please label them. Last week's muffin was claimed by mysterious wildlife. :eyes: 
Priya: Kudos to Ken for sticker diplomacy. Also planting a small 'adopted' card. 
Zoe: Bonus one-liner thread for the road: 'If plants could email, this one would BCC everyone.' 
Dante: Noted: cactus office hours are 10–10:05 AM, bring tiny beverages. 
Molly: Thread closed. Plant debut at next all-hands? :seedling:
